Sandbox_ChooseStartingVehicle_Enabled_to: Parks the vehicle you built on the character creation screen near your spawn point when a new game starts.
Sandbox_ChooseStartingVehicle_PartCondit: Condition of every installed part of the vehicle and trailer. 100 is like new, with no rust.
Sandbox_ChooseStartingVehicle_FuelPercen: How full the gas tank is.
Sandbox_ChooseStartingVehicle_KeyInPocke: Puts the key in your inventory. Turn it off to leave the key in the glove box instead.
Sandbox_ChooseStartingVehicle_SearchRadi: How far from your spawn point the mod looks for room to park. Roads and parking lots are tried first.
Sandbox_ChooseStartingVehicle_AllowTrail: Spawns the trailer or camper you chose, hitched behind the vehicle.
Sandbox_ChooseStartingVehicle_AllowCargo: Packs the items you chose into the trunk, glove box and trailer.
